plot.new()   segments(0.12, 0.5, 0.2, 0.5, col = axis_col, lwd = 2.5)   text(0.22, 0.5, "medial axis", adj = 0, cex = 0.75)   symbols(0.6, 0.5, circles = 0.03, inches = FALSE, add = TRUE, fg = "grey55", lwd = 0.8)   text(0.65, 0.5, "inscribed disc", adj = 0, cex = 0.75)   par(mar = c(0.2, 0.2, 2.2, 0.2)) } # The medial axis in the package's one encoding: red, thinner than the ink. axis_col <- eval(formals(draw_mat_axis)$col, environment(draw_mat_axis)) # A handful of inscribed discs, at the axis points nearest to chosen spots: a # window pane, the wall, the floor, under the table, by the lamp, the picture. axis_points <- do.call(rbind, lapply(scene_mat$mat$branches, function(b) b[, c("x", "y", "radius")])) spots <- rbind(c(42, 47), c(103, 55), c(100, 128), c(172, 147), c(140, 28), c(213, 61)) disc_points <- axis_points[apply(spots, 1, function(p)   which.min((axis_points$x - p[1])^2 + (axis_points$y - p[2])^2)), ] disc_points <- disc_points[with(disc_points, x - radius > 0.5 & x + radius < 240.5 &                                   y - radius > 0.5 & y + radius < 160.5), ] # Mapped scores drawn `widen` pixels to each side of the ink, so their colour # can be read at a glance. pc <- col + epsilon * sin(a[s])     near <- NULL     for (r in cells(pr)) for (k in cells(pc)) {       d2 <- (ink_rc[, 1] - r)^2 + (ink_rc[, 2] - k)^2       near <- rbind(near, ink_rc[d2 == min(d2), , drop = FALSE])     }     near <- unique(near)     u <- cbind(near[, 1] - pr, near[, 2] - pc) / sqrt((near[, 1] - pr)^2 + (near[, 2] - pc)^2)     v <- colMeans(u)     # the first and last of the equally near ink pixels (the same pixel when unique)     c(x = pc, y = pr, dx = v[2], dy = v[1], contribution = sum(v * c(cos(a[s]), sin(a[s]))),       ink_x = unname(near[1, 2]), ink_y = unname(near[1, 1]),       ink_x2 = unname(near[nrow(near), 2]), ink_y2 = unname(near[nrow(near), 1]))   }, numeric(9))) } probes$flux <- mapply(function(r, k) sum(flux_samples(r, k)[, "contribution"]),                       probes$row, probes$col) probes #>   row col       name       flux #> 1  24  40      Ridge  33.513004 #> 2  10  40 Above line   0.377034 #> 3  18   7   Line end -10.145035 #> 4  45  25    Under V  10.059189 half <- 8                                     # window: 2 * half + 1 pixels wide every <- 5                                    # draw every 5th of the samples cut_flux <- mat$parameters$threshold * mat$parameters$samples sign_col <- c(inward = "#2E5EAA", outward = "#B2182B") minus <- function(v) sub("^-", "\u2212", sprintf("%.1f", v))   # a true minus sign bar_lim <- range(c(0, probes$flux, cut_flux)) + c(-22, 6) layout(matrix(1:8, 2, byrow = TRUE), heights = c(1, 0.32)) op <- par(mar = c(0.3, 0.3, 1.4, 0.3), cex = 0.85, cex.main = 0.95) for (k in seq_len(nrow(probes))) {   r <- probes$row[k];
